column1: # املای مرجّح فرهنگستان — دستور خطّ فارسی (ویراست جدید)، صص ۷۳–۸۱،
# Left column: a spelling the standard lists as existing. Right column: the one
# it marks مرجّح. Only rows where the standard names a single preferred form are
# here; a row that prints both as correct (توفان/طوفان، نعنا/نعناع، سرشک/سرشگ،
# باتون/باتوم، پیشخوان، بختنصر) is not an error either way and is absent.
# Also absent, on purpose, and this is the interesting exclusion: rows the
# standard resolves *by sense*, where the rejected spelling is an ordinary word
# in another meaning — آخر/آخور، تاق/طاق (سقف vs مقابل جفت)، تراز/طراز،
# تاس/طاس، تایر/طایر، ختمی/خطمی، قرق/غرق، هیز/حیز، انتر/عنتر، آقا/آغا،
# ارک/ارگ. Flagging those needs a sense the detector does not have.
# Rows whose preferred form contains a ZWNJ we cannot see in the source's text
# layer (الم‌شنگه، طاس‌کباب، ترق‌وتوروق، قاروقور، لق‌لق، وق‌وق، نق‌نق،
# قره‌قروت) are absent rather than guessed at: a repair must be exact.
# The proper-name index on pp. 82–85 is a separate list and is not extracted.
